newsitem.title: USA: US stocks steady at higher levels, financials firm.
newsitem.headline: US stocks steady at higher levels, financials firm.

text.p: Wall Street stocks held to moderate gains in mid-afternoon, led by a strong performance by financial stocks.

The Dow industrials were up 31 points at 6770. Gainers held a narrow 12-11 edge over declining issues. The Phildelphia Stock Exchange's bank index .BKX was up 13 points, or 2.3 percent, to 567 as big money center banks staged a solid rally.
Citicorp gained 3-1/2 to 106-7/8, J.P. Morgan & Co Inc climbed 1-3/4 to 97-5/8, Chase Manhattan Corp rose two to 87-3/8, and Wells Fargo and Co jumped 9-1/8 to 259-3/4.

"It looks like the banking index may start to trend toward its 50-day moving average of 590," said Peter Green, vice president of technical research at Gruntal & Co. "So it looks like we could get a near-term bounce that's actually better than I had been expecting."
The Nasdaq Composite rose seven points to 1217 and the S&P 500 gained eight to 773.
